2021 Q3.bq: Despite the suspension of new user registrations, our total revenues reached RMB 1.2 billion in the quarter, up 105% year on year, beating the high end of our guidance range.

2021 Q4.bq: In this quarter, our total revenues increased by 69% to RMB 1.09 billion, beating the high end of our guidance range and our total revenues for the full year of 2021 achieved 119% growth to RMB 4.26 billion, with online recruitment and services revenue accounting for about 99% of our total revenues.

2022 Q1.bq: In this quarter, our total revenues increased by 44% to RMB 1.14 billion, beating the high end of our guidance range.
